draft_feature_statistics.semantics: Labels were assigned to SAM2 drafts; neither material identity nor class truth is verified.
draft_feature_statistics.aggregation: Unit-normalize descriptors; weight each patch by surviving class pixels; normalize weighted centre.
draft_feature_statistics.within_definition: Pixel-weighted mean (1 - cosine(patch, normalized class centre)).
draft_feature_statistics.between_definition: 1 - cosine(normalized class centres); ratio divides by mean of both within dispersions.

limitations: Unlabelled pixels are unknown and never treated as substrate.
A 14-pixel patch may mix narrow residue, structure, shadows and unknown pixels.
DINO descriptors use global attention, so a patch descriptor is not purely local material response.
Drafts from another model are not independent human ground truth; no accuracy or class classifier is produced.
Per-image centres describe these two images only; no generalization or statistical significance is inferred.
